snippet.title: ONE MAN'S TRASH - GAME REVEAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
He lost 8000 PitCoins.
He bought a junkyard.
Now, he's digging through mountains of trash, upgrading gear, dodging giant underground worms, and searching for one lost hard drive worth $1,000,000.

🧹 Vacuum trash.
🛠️ Upgrade your equipment.
🕳️ Dig deeper and uncover hidden secrets.
🎯 Find rare treasures, pop culture relics, and ultimate loot.
😱 Face dangers lurking below the surface.

One Man’s Trash is a chaotic, funny, and surprisingly deep indie game about obsession, treasure hunting, and making a fortune... out of garbage.
